buildingExclusions.reason: No name to call it by: it has no name tag and no building code (ref). The surroundings draw it as they draw any other building, unless it overlaps one of Waikato's buildings on the map or covers less than 12 square metres.

buildingExclusions.sourceText: building=university; name=Waikato Medical School construction site
buildingExclusions.reason: Its name calls it a construction site: the place where a building is going up, not a building in use. The surroundings draw it as they draw any other building, unless it overlaps one of Waikato's buildings on the map or covers less than 12 square metres.
